title: In Chamundeshwari, veteran JD(S) leader G.T. Deve Gowda says he matters more than JD(S)
description: Mr. Gowda’s massive rally, organised following his re-election as president of the Karnataka State Co-operative Federation, comes amid his increasingly strained relations with the JD(S) leadership, particularly Union Minister for Heavy Industries and Steel H.D. Kumaraswamy.
